reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was the QR and 'Every batch lab-tested', which sounds like marketing to me because everyone says tested. A dollar a day for magnesium is more than I pay, and I wait for a flash sale or coupon anyway.
objection: Thirty bucks for 30 days when I can get a big bottle of magnesium glycinate for half that. The sachet and the nice box look like I'm paying for packaging, and I can't tell if the QR report is real until I've already paid.
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon that brings a box to about $19 or less, or a cheap trial size so I can scan the QR and see a real report before committing.
